text_block_list.text:
It's the 25th of December. We're at a
pause in
Gold City's racing schedule, so
I'm taking the
time to think about next
year when...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Bzzzt... Bzzzzt...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Hey, Тренер? Do you have a minute?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
So listen, I need you to come meet me at
this
location right away. Don't bring
anything. Bye.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Trainer!
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
You do know what day it is today, right?
Then
there's your answer.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Anyway, I've got a present for you, so...
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: I want you to get changed downstairs.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
She takes me downstairs to a fitting
room holding
tons of clothes. And
before I know what's
happening...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
City! I dressed your trainer just as
requested!
text_block_list.name: Stylist

text_block_list.text:
Ohh! That looks really good! I knew I
was right to
ask you for help.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
No compliments on my makeup? I'd say I

enhanced your trainer's charm precisely
how you
asked.
text_block_list.name: Makeup Artist

text_block_list.text: Yeah, it's perfect. Thank you.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's no problem at all! I'm just
thrilled to be
spending the holiday with
you! ♪
text_block_list.name: Makeup Artist

text_block_list.text: Are you ready? Let's start the shoot.
text_block_list.name: Photographer

text_block_list.text:
Okay! Everyone, thank you for taking a
little time
out of your busy schedules to
help me here! I
really appreciate it.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Yup, it's my present to you—a
professional photo
shoot.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Everyone here is a top-tier artist. Even

professional models rarely get to work
with this
kind of talent.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
They're going to make you look
amazing.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
No wimping out. All right, let's get
started.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Okay, Trainer, right this way!
text_block_list.name: Photographer

text_block_list.text:
And so I find myself somehow roped into
a photo
shoot of my very own.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Trainer, your expression is looking a bit
stiff. Is
the light too harsh? Do you want
it a bit dimmer?
text_block_list.name: Photographer

text_block_list.text:
...You're mega-nervous. Where's your
usual
unbridled enthusiasm?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Hmm... Sorry, can we have a moment?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Listen, Trainer. I'm right here.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Just keep your eyes on me, and you
won't be
bothered by the surroundings.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
What's there that could captivate you
more than
me?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
That's right—just focus on me. The
professionals
will take care of the rest.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Голд Сити smiles at me reassuringly. As I
gaze at
her, I stop worrying about the
voices around me
and the blinding
lights, until...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Good work, Trainer! Take a quick break
while we
review the photos.
text_block_list.name: Photographer

text_block_list.text:
The photo shoot ends before I know it!
Seeing
myself in the monitor, I appear
like an entirely
different person.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Haha, of course it is! You're looking
really good
too.
text_block_list.name: Photographer

text_block_list.text:
I think you look your best when you're
totally
focused on something. City must
have realized
that too.
text_block_list.name: Photographer

text_block_list.text:
Good job, Trainer. I think you got some
good
shots in there.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити
choice_data_list:
I barely remember anything that happened after
the first half...

text_block_list.text:
Hahaha. I guess that means I did my job
properly
too.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити
choice_data_list: Why did you do all this, though?

text_block_list.text:
I tried to think of the best gift I could
possibly
offer you.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
And this was what I came up with—to
show you a
whole new side of yourself.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
You taught me something similar before,
you
know.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
When you're photographed by a
professional,
you can discover what's
appealing about
yourself—things you
never knew. Isn't that
exciting?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
So I asked some of my colleagues to get
together.
Was it, uh... too much, you
think?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
I was indeed very confused at first, but...
I do feel
like I understand a part of
myself I didn't know
before this shoot.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: Thank you for the best present ever.

text_block_list.text: Mhm. I'm glad you enjoyed it.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Anyway, don't you have anything for
me?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
If I gave you the best present ever, then
you have
to give me something better,
right?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
What should I ask for? Maybe a luxury
bag? I've
been wanting to check out the
latest pieces.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Pfft, I'm just kidding.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Hahaha... Like, how are you not used to
this by
now? Oh, I can't!
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Oh, there you are! Listen, we were
thinking of
taking some shots of you two
together.
text_block_list.name: Photographer

text_block_list.text: Huh? Me and Тренер?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Yes! Everyone's so fired up to get both
of you
dressed up for some shots with
each other.
text_block_list.name: Photographer

text_block_list.text:
I think it could make for some great
photos, too.
You don't mind, right?
text_block_list.name: Photographer

text_block_list.text:
Well, if everyone says so, I guess we can
give it a
try.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Heh, you're all nervous again. Remember
what I
said—you'll be fine if you just
look at me.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: You've got the support of a top model!
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Flash! Flash! Flash!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Now, put your hand here. That's good.
Stay still...
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
And so the holiday night ticks away to
the tune of
City's merry laughter.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It's one nervous moment after another,
but we
make it through the shoot. And
as Голд Сити
looks through the photos of
us together, I can see
a smile on her
face.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
